We've got the draft disposition plan in front of us — scenic pieces heading to general salvage, selected hero props going to production storage. Before I can approve anything, I need each department lead to confirm their exact disposition and environmental-compliance requirements, and flag any exceptions to the draft with the exact corrective requirement on the record. Who wants to go first?

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan on the environmental-compliance side. The city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill. I confirmed with the vendor this morning that the approved vendor's audited plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. However, the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft. The corrective requirement is: replace the general-salvage disposition for scenic pieces with the approved vendor's audited recycling plan using separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record, and update the compliance packet accordingly before the plan is locked.
